bagPolicy.summary: Small purses and fanny packs up to 12” x 12” x 6” are allowed. Backpacks of any kind or size are prohibited.
allowed: Small purses and fanny packs up to 12” x 12” x 6
prohibited: Backpacks of any kind or size
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: There is ample paid parking available at Nashville Yards in multiple garages, including Nashville Yards, Pinnacle Tower, and Amazon Towers. The garages are gateless for easy entry/exit, and event parking rates vary by event.

rideshare.note: Use the rideshare pickup and drop-off area at 9th Avenue North and Commerce Street.

concessions.note: The Pinnacle offers a variety of food and drink options to enhance the concert experience. While specific vendors are not listed, the venue likely features local and popular concessions to cater to diverse tastes.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The Pinnacle is fully ADA compliant, with elevator access to every level. Buy ADA tickets on AXS.com, and email thepinnacleinfo@aegpresents.com well before your show for specific accommodations. The Nashville Yards garages have elevators to the venue level; the East Garage at 140 10th Ave N gives the smoothest arrival.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: You can't re-enter The Pinnacle once you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The box office is open Tuesday to Saturday, 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. On show days it opens two hours before doors and stays open until the headliner starts. Tickets are AXS Mobile ID digital tickets and can only be transferred through AXS.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Enter through the main entrance at 910 Exchange Ln., which is accessible; two elevators are on the right once you're inside. A Quick Pass upgrade, sold at the Box Office or on AXS.com, lets you skip the main line when doors open, but it is not early entry.
